notes.title: Backyard Football '99 Patch Update 🚨
notes.notes:
Hi-ho, Sports fans! 🏈


The Backyard Football '99 1.0.5 patch notes are here to deliver smoother and more stable gameplay. We've been at work on crushing all the bugs and improving the game, and here's a list of what's new:



🏈 Updated logos

Felines

Bulldozers

Geckos

Cheetahs

Ostriches

Crabs

Pickles

Buffalos



🏈 Bug Fixes

We fixed a bug where a game is marked as an L on the schedule page when the player achieves a 3-digit point.

Fixed a bug where players can't switch directly between weather options when returning from the team bench.



We're committed to making Backyard Football '99 the best it can be! If you encounter any new bugs after the patch, please keep sending them our way. Your feedback is crucial!



How to Report Bugs:
